purpose: Move the math program from broad debt listing toward staged resolution by separating primitive closure, organizational closure, topology closure, residue closure, projection closure, and economics buildability.
governance_instruction: Do not attempt to close downstream bridges before the primitive participation rules are explicit.

priority_order.name: Primitive Participation Closure
priority_order.reason: These symbols appear inside later definitions and cannot remain implicit.

priority_order.name: Organizational Closure
priority_order.reason: Org_a and Sigma_D determine what counts as preserved admissible distinction organization.

priority_order.name: Topology Closure
priority_order.reason: Topology cannot close until orientation participates legally in admissible class selection.

priority_order.name: Residue Calculus Closure
priority_order.reason: Residue must be separated from residue-coupling before projection and economics can be traceable.

priority_order.name: Projection Calculus Closure
priority_order.reason: Domain-specific mathematics must be extracted from admissible relational structure without projection-only drift.

priority_order.name: Economics Buildability
priority_order.reason: Economics_app becomes buildable only after admissible organization, topology, residue, and projection rules are closed.

immediate_resolution_target.definition_goal: Define the vertical bar as the admissible distinction-participation separator inside grouped expressions.
immediate_resolution_target.candidate_reading: A | B marks the oriented comparison interface through which A and B participate in a distinction-generating expression.
immediate_resolution_target.closure_question: When does a grouped bar expression preserve enough admissible orientation to participate in Org_a?

secondary_resolution_target.definition_goal: Define Orientation Space as the space of admissible participation directions available to distinction organizations.
secondary_resolution_target.candidate_reading: O indexes how distinction participates, not merely where an object is located.
secondary_resolution_target.bridge_hypothesis: Orientation functions as a topological selector constraint on admissible knot-class selection.

candidate_axioms.name: Inventory Preservation
candidate_axioms.draft: An admissible organization must preserve the participating distinction inventory across legal transformation.

candidate_axioms.name: Admissibility Conservation
candidate_axioms.draft: Every transformation inside Org_a must preserve satisfaction of the admissibility predicate.

candidate_axioms.name: Topological Consistency
candidate_axioms.draft: The organization must preserve relational participation structure up to admissible equivalence.

Sigma_D_resolution_frame.definition_goal: Define when two admissible distinction organizations count as the same preserved organization.
must_include: same admissible recovery behavior under perturbation
